_why: Beast Mastery's redesign repurposed four baseline spells -- Scare Beast
into Lacerating Shot, Beast Lore into Instinctive Fire, Aspect of the Beast
into Beast Cleave and Freezing Arrow into Pack Hunting -- and the premade
build takes none of the talents that make them worth pressing:
Taste for Blood 3/3     (T4.3) pet attacks on a Lacerating Shot target
deal an extra 15% of YOUR ranged attack power.
This is the Beast Mastery loop: Lacerating Shot
uptime is the rotation, and without this talent
the bleed is just a bleed.
Invigoration 2/2        (T7.0) pet special crits reset Instinctive Fire
and make it free. Instinctive Fire is 20% ranged
haste, so this is the pet feeding the hunter
rather than the other way round.
Superior Training 2/2   (T3.1) Bite Back and Well-Trained. Pet
survivability, which for Beast Mastery is
throughput -- a dead pet is most of the damage.
Funded by:
Longevity 3/3           cuts the cooldowns of Bestial Wrath, Intimidation
and Kill Command. Largely redundant now: Animal
Handler already procs Bestial Wrath off ranged
attacks, and Catlike Reflexes already takes 30
seconds off Kill Command.
Endurance Training 1/5, Spirit Bond 1/2  two stray single points. Tier 0
still holds 5 for the tier-1 gate.
Aimed Shot 1/1 and Go for the Throat 1/2  two points out of the
Marksmanship dip. Aimed Shot is a Marksmanship
button this rotation never presses.
58 Beast Mastery / 13 Marksmanship.
